2609.00892.title: CARE: Contrastive Anchor-based Rubric Evolution for Large Language Model Post-Training
2609.00892.paper_summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes open-ended instructions into prompt-specific, flexible rubrics, making it better suited than reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for post-training LLMs on open-ended tasks. However, static rubrics are inevitably hacked as the policy evolves, and existing dynamic approaches introduce new problems: undirected rubric extraction, unreliable hack detection, and unbounded rubric proliferation. We propose $\textbf{CARE}$ ($\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{A}$nchor-based $\textbf{R}$ubric $\textbf{E}$volution), which grounds every rubric evolution step in a high-quality anchor response generated by a frontier model conditioned on the prompt and its rubrics. At each training step, CARE contrasts the highest-scoring rollout against the anchor, enabling two complementary mechanisms: an Adaptive branch that reactively repairs reward misspecification; and a Chase branch that proactively converts frontier-level quality gaps into sharper rubrics. Together, the two branches $\textbf{maintain discriminative accuracy in the high-reward region}$---the precise region where reward over-optimization mostly originates. Experiments on WildChecklist-9K with Qwen2.5-7B-Base and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance on Arena-Hard-2.0, InfoBench, and FollowBench, and is the $\textbf{only}$ method whose win rate against GPT-4.1 anchor responses shows sustained improvement throughout 300 training steps; additional results on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B further indicate that CARE generalizes across model families.
2609.00892.paper_summary_zh: 基於評分標準的強化學習將開放式指令分解為特定於提示的靈活評分標準，使其比具有可驗證獎勵的強化學習更適合於開放式任務的後訓練 LLM。然而，隨著策略的演變，靜態評分標準不可避免地被破解，而現有的動態方法則引入了新的問題：無導向的評分標準提取、不可靠的破解檢測和無界的評分標準擴散。我們提出了 $\textbf{CARE}$ ($\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{A}$nchor-based $\textbf{R}$ubric $\textbf{E}$volution)，該方法將每一步評分標準的演變基於由前沿模型生成的高質量錨點回應，該模型是基於提示及其評分標準進行條件化的。在每個訓練步驟中，CARE 將得分最高的回應與錨點進行對比，從而啟用兩個互補的機制：一個自適應分支，反應性地修復獎勵錯誤規範；以及一個追逐分支，主動將前沿水平的質量差距轉化為更精確的評分標準。這兩個分支共同 $\textbf{維持高獎勵區域的區分準確性}$——即獎勵過度優化主要來源的精確區域。在使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 WildChecklist-9K 上進行的實驗顯示，CARE 在 Arena-Hard-2.0、InfoBench 和 FollowBench 上達到了最先進的性能，並且是唯一一種在 300 個訓練步驟中對 GPT-4.1 錨點回應的勝率顯示持續改善的方法；對 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 的額外結果進一步表明，CARE 在模型家族之間具有良好的泛化能力。
